svg.title: Path
svg.desc: 2022: Bachelor’s degree. Web development. Capstone: a full-stack app in Angular and Spring Boot. 2023: Instructor, Coding Dojo. Two years teaching full-stack development across the web, Python and C# stacks. 2025: Co-founder, CodePal. Client software: a bus operations console, storefronts, Flux Convert. 2026: Open source for Tunisia. tunisia-kit, Open-Codemap and Map Tunisia, while building my own products.
